q_gram_b2_01_001.question: Si yo ___ más dinero, viajaría por el mundo. (tener)
q_gram_b2_01_001.explanation: Dopo 'si' in a hypothetical condition, il/la past congiuntivo (-ra form) è obbligatorio. Tener becomes tuviera da il/la irregolare passato remoto radice tuv-.
q_gram_b2_01_001.hint: Use il/la past congiuntivo (-ra form) di tener

q_gram_b2_01_002.question: Mis padres querían que yo ___ medicina en la universidad. (estudiar)
q_gram_b2_01_002.explanation: Dopo 'querían que', il/la past congiuntivo è necessario perché il/la main verbo è in a past tense. Estudiar becomes estudiara in il/la past congiuntivo.
q_gram_b2_01_002.hint: Il/la main verbo è past tense, so il/la congiuntivo deve anche essere past

q_gram_b2_01_003.question: Cosa sono il/la two forms di il/la past congiuntivo in spagnolo?
q_gram_b2_01_003.correct: The -ra form (hablara) and the -se form (hablase), both derived from the third person preterite stem
wrong: The -ra form from the infinitive and the -se form from the present
q_gram_b2_01_003.explanation: Il/la past congiuntivo ha two interchangeable forms: -ra (hablara, comieras) e -se (hablase, comieses). Both sono formed da il/la ellos/ellas passato remoto radice.

q_gram_b2_01_004.question: Ella ___ en esa empresa si pudiera. (trabajar, past congiuntivo, ella form)
q_gram_b2_01_004.explanation: Il/la past congiuntivo di trabajar in il/la ella form è trabajara. Esso è formed da il/la passato remoto radice (trabajaron → trabajar-) plus il/la -a ending.
q_gram_b2_01_004.conjugation_info: trabajar (past subjunctive): trabajara, trabajaras, trabajara, trabajáramos, trabajarais, trabajaran

q_gram_b2_01_005.question: El médico recomendó que el paciente ___ más ejercicio. (hacer)
q_gram_b2_01_005.explanation: Dopo 'recomendó que', il/la past congiuntivo è necessario. Hacer ha an irregolare passato remoto radice (hic-), so il/la past congiuntivo è hiciera.
q_gram_b2_01_005.hint: Hacer ha an irregolare passato remoto radice

q_gram_b2_01_006.question: Nosotros ___ al concierto si nos invitaran. (ir, past congiuntivo, forma nosotros)
q_gram_b2_01_006.explanation: Il/la past congiuntivo di ir in il/la forma nosotros è fuéramos, da il/la irregolare passato remoto radice fu-. Note il/la accent on il/la first e.
q_gram_b2_01_006.conjugation_info: ir (past subjunctive): fuera, fueras, fuera, fuéramos, fuerais, fueran

q_gram_b2_01_007.question: No había nadie que ___ resolver el problema tan complicado. (poder)
q_gram_b2_01_007.explanation: Dopo 'no había nadie que', il/la past congiuntivo è necessario perché esso si riferisce a a non-existent antecedent in a past context. Poder becomes pudiera da il/la passato remoto radice pud-.
q_gram_b2_01_007.hint: Dopo a negative antecedent in il/la past, use past congiuntivo

q_gram_b2_01_008.question: If I erano rich, I sarebbe travel il/la world.
q_gram_b2_01_008.correct: Si yo fuera rico, viajaría por el mundo.
wrong: Si yo sería rico, viajaba por el mundo.
Si yo era rico, viajaría por el mundo.
Si yo fui rico, viajé por el mundo.
q_gram_b2_01_008.explanation: In Type 2 conditionals, Spagnolo uses 'si + past congiuntivo' (fuera) in il/la if-clause e il/la condizionale (viajaría) in il/la main clause.

q_gram_b2_01_009.question: Vosotros ___ mejor si practicarais más. (cantar, past congiuntivo, forma vosotros)
q_gram_b2_01_009.explanation: Il/la forma vosotros di il/la past congiuntivo di cantar è cantarais, da il/la passato remoto radice cantar- plus -ais.
q_gram_b2_01_009.conjugation_info: cantar (past subjunctive): cantara, cantaras, cantara, cantáramos, cantarais, cantaran

q_gram_b2_01_010.question: Ojalá que mis amigos estuvieran aquí para celebrar conmigo.
q_gram_b2_01_010.correct: I wish my friends were here to celebrate with me.
wrong: I hope my friends are here to celebrate with me.
My friends wished they were here to celebrate with me.
I wished my friends had been here to celebrate with me.
q_gram_b2_01_010.explanation: 'Ojalá que' + past congiuntivo (estuvieran) esprime a wish about a present situation quello è unlikely o contrary a reality, translated as 'I wish... erano'.

q_gram_b2_02_001.question: Si ella ___ tiempo, iría al gimnasio. (tener, past congiuntivo, ella form)
q_gram_b2_02_001.explanation: In a Type 2 condizionale, il/la si-clause requires il/la past congiuntivo. Tener's past congiuntivo ella form è tuviera, da il/la irregolare passato remoto radice tuv-.
q_gram_b2_02_001.conjugation_info: tener (past subjunctive): tuviera, tuvieras, tuviera, tuviéramos, tuvierais, tuvieran

q_gram_b2_02_002.question: Si ___ buen tiempo, iríamos a la playa. (hacer)
q_gram_b2_02_002.explanation: In a Type 2 condizionale (unreal present), 'si' è seguito da il/la past congiuntivo. Hacer becomes hiciera da il/la irregolare passato remoto radice hic-.
q_gram_b2_02_002.hint: Questo è un unreal present condition

q_gram_b2_02_003.question: Si nosotros ___ ricos, compraríamos una casa en la playa. (ser)
q_gram_b2_02_003.explanation: In a Type 2 condizionale, il/la si-clause requires il/la past congiuntivo. Ser shares its past congiuntivo forms con ir: fuéramos (nosotros).
q_gram_b2_02_003.hint: Ser e ir share il/la same past congiuntivo forms

q_gram_b2_02_004.question: Cosa è il/la structure di a Type 2 condizionale sentence in spagnolo?
q_gram_b2_02_004.correct: Si + past subjunctive (imperfect subjunctive), conditional tense in the main clause
wrong: Si + present indicative, future tense in the main clause
Si + imperfect indicative, conditional tense in the main clause
Si + conditional tense, past subjunctive in the main clause
q_gram_b2_02_004.explanation: Type 2 conditionals express unreal o unlikely present/future situations. Il/la si-clause takes il/la past congiuntivo (e.g., tuviera) e il/la result clause uses il/la condizionale (e.g., compraría).

q_gram_b2_02_005.question: Yo ___ más contentos a mis padres si sacara buenas notas. (hacer, condizionale, forma yo)
q_gram_b2_02_005.explanation: In il/la main clause di a Type 2 condizionale, il/la condizionale tense si usa. Hacer in il/la yo condizionale form è haría, using il/la irregolare radice har-.
q_gram_b2_02_005.conjugation_info: hacer (conditional): haría, harías, haría, haríamos, haríais, harían

q_gram_b2_02_006.question: Si tú ___ más cuidado, no cometerías tantos errores. (tener)
q_gram_b2_02_006.explanation: In il/la si-clause di a Type 2 condizionale, il/la past congiuntivo è obbligatorio. Il/la forma tú di tener in il/la past congiuntivo è tuvieras.
q_gram_b2_02_006.hint: Il/la si-clause needs past congiuntivo, not indicativo o condizionale

q_gram_b2_02_007.question: If loro lived closer, we sarebbe see them more spesso.
q_gram_b2_02_007.correct: Si ellos vivieran más cerca, los veríamos más a menudo.
wrong: Si ellos vivirían más cerca, los veíamos más a menudo.
Si ellos vivían más cerca, los veríamos más a menudo.
Si ellos viven más cerca, los veremos más a menudo.
q_gram_b2_02_007.explanation: Questo è un Type 2 condizionale. 'Si' + past congiuntivo (vivieran) esprime il/la unreal condition, e il/la condizionale (veríamos) esprime il/la hypothetical result.

q_gram_b2_02_008.question: Si yo ___ hablar chino, buscaría trabajo en Pekín. (saber)
q_gram_b2_02_008.explanation: Dopo 'si' in a hypothetical condition, il/la past congiuntivo è obbligatorio. Saber's past congiuntivo è supiera, da il/la irregolare passato remoto radice sup-.
q_gram_b2_02_008.hint: Saber ha an irregolare passato remoto radice

q_gram_b2_02_009.question: Si yo pudiera elegir cualquier profesión, sería astronauta.
q_gram_b2_02_009.correct: If I could choose any profession, I would be an astronaut.
wrong: If I can choose any profession, I will be an astronaut.
If I was able to choose any profession, I was an astronaut.
If I would choose any profession, I would be an astronaut.
q_gram_b2_02_009.explanation: Questo è un Type 2 condizionale: 'si pudiera' (past congiuntivo) = 'if I potrebbe', e 'sería' (condizionale) = 'I sarebbe essere'. Esso esprime an unreal present situation.

q_gram_b2_02_010.question: Ellos ___ en Europa si consiguieran un buen trabajo allí. (vivir, condizionale, ellos form)
q_gram_b2_02_010.explanation: In il/la main clause di a Type 2 condizionale, il/la condizionale tense si usa. Vivir in il/la ellos condizionale form è vivirían (infinito + -ían).
q_gram_b2_02_010.conjugation_info: vivir (conditional): viviría, vivirías, viviría, viviríamos, viviríais, vivirían

q_gram_b2_03_001.question: Si yo hubiera sabido la verdad, no ___ eso. (decir, condizionale perfect)
q_gram_b2_03_001.explanation: In a Type 3 condizionale, il/la main clause uses il/la condizionale perfect (habría + participio passato). Decir's participio passato è il/la irregolare dicho.
q_gram_b2_03_001.hint: Il/la main clause di a Type 3 condizionale uses condizionale perfect

q_gram_b2_03_002.question: Si ellos ___ estudiado más, habrían aprobado el examen. (haber, trapassato congiuntivo)
q_gram_b2_03_002.explanation: In a Type 3 condizionale, il/la si-clause uses il/la trapassato congiuntivo (hubiera/hubiese + participio passato). Il/la ellos form è hubieran.
q_gram_b2_03_002.hint: Il/la si-clause in Type 3 needs trapassato congiuntivo

q_gram_b2_03_003.question: Cosa does a Type 3 condizionale sentence express in spagnolo?
q_gram_b2_03_003.correct: An unreal or impossible condition in the past and its hypothetical consequence
wrong: A probable condition in the present with a likely outcome
An unreal condition in the present with a hypothetical outcome
A real condition in the past with a factual consequence
q_gram_b2_03_003.explanation: Type 3 conditionals (si + trapassato congiuntivo, condizionale perfect) express situations quello sono contrary a cosa actually happened in il/la past. Loro describe missed opportunities o regrets.

q_gram_b2_03_004.question: Nosotros ___ antes si hubiéramos tenido el mapa. (llegar, condizionale perfect, forma nosotros)
q_gram_b2_03_004.explanation: Il/la condizionale perfect in il/la forma nosotros è habríamos + participio passato. Llegar's participio passato è llegado (regolare).
q_gram_b2_03_004.conjugation_info: llegar (conditional perfect): habría llegado, habrías llegado, habría llegado, habríamos llegado, habríais llegado, habrían llegado

q_gram_b2_03_005.question: Si tú no ___ enfadado, no habríamos discutido. (haberse, trapassato congiuntivo)
q_gram_b2_03_005.explanation: In il/la si-clause, il/la trapassato congiuntivo è obbligatorio. Con reflexive verbs, il pronome precedes il/la auxiliary: 'te hubieras enfadado'.
q_gram_b2_03_005.hint: Reflexive pronome + trapassato congiuntivo di haber

q_gram_b2_03_006.question: Yo ___ de casa antes si hubiera sonado la alarma. (salir, condizionale perfect, forma yo)
q_gram_b2_03_006.explanation: Il/la condizionale perfect (habría + participio passato) si usa in il/la main clause di a Type 3 condizionale. Salir's participio passato è salido (regolare).
q_gram_b2_03_006.conjugation_info: salir (conditional perfect): habría salido, habrías salido, habría salido, habríamos salido, habríais salido, habrían salido

q_gram_b2_03_007.question: Si ella ___ la oferta, ahora tendría un trabajo mejor. (aceptar, trapassato congiuntivo)
q_gram_b2_03_007.explanation: In a mixed condizionale (past condition, present result), il/la si-clause still uses il/la trapassato congiuntivo: hubiera aceptado.
q_gram_b2_03_007.hint: Questo è un mixed condizionale con a past condition

q_gram_b2_03_008.question: If we aveva arrived earlier, we sarebbe avere gotten better seats.
q_gram_b2_03_008.correct: Si hubiéramos llegado antes, habríamos conseguido mejores asientos.
wrong: Si llegáramos antes, conseguiríamos mejores asientos.
Si habíamos llegado antes, habríamos conseguido mejores asientos.
Si hubiéramos llegado antes, conseguimos mejores asientos.
q_gram_b2_03_008.explanation: Questo è un Type 3 condizionale: 'si hubiéramos llegado' (trapassato congiuntivo) + 'habríamos conseguido' (condizionale perfect). Esso descrive an unreal past scenario.

q_gram_b2_03_009.question: Vosotros ___ la respuesta si hubierais leído el capítulo. (saber, condizionale perfect, forma vosotros)
q_gram_b2_03_009.explanation: Il/la vosotros condizionale perfect è habríais + participio passato. Saber's participio passato è sabido (regolare).
q_gram_b2_03_009.conjugation_info: saber (conditional perfect): habría sabido, habrías sabido, habría sabido, habríamos sabido, habríais sabido, habrían sabido

q_gram_b2_03_010.question: Si hubieran cerrado la ventana, no se habría mojado el suelo.
q_gram_b2_03_010.correct: If they had closed the window, the floor would not have gotten wet.
wrong: If they closed the window, the floor would not get wet.
If they would close the window, the floor would not have gotten wet.
If they had closed the window, the floor did not get wet.
q_gram_b2_03_010.explanation: Questo è un Type 3 condizionale. 'Si hubieran cerrado' = 'if loro aveva closed' (trapassato congiuntivo), e 'no se habría mojado' = 'sarebbe not avere gotten wet' (condizionale perfect).

q_gram_b2_04_001.question: Ella ___ el proyecto antes del plazo. (terminar, condizionale perfect, ella form)
q_gram_b2_04_001.explanation: Il/la condizionale perfect è formed con il/la condizionale di haber (habría) + participio passato. Terminar's participio passato è terminado.
q_gram_b2_04_001.conjugation_info: terminar (conditional perfect): habría terminado, habrías terminado, habría terminado, habríamos terminado, habríais terminado, habrían terminado

q_gram_b2_04_002.question: En tu lugar, yo ___ la oportunidad sin dudarlo. (aprovechar, condizionale perfect)
q_gram_b2_04_002.explanation: Il/la condizionale perfect esprime cosa someone sarebbe avere done. 'En tu lugar' (in il tuo place) sets up a hypothetical past scenario: habría aprovechado.
q_gram_b2_04_002.hint: 'En tu lugar' introduces a hypothetical situation

q_gram_b2_04_003.question: Nosotros ___ la noticia, pero nadie nos llamó. (creer, condizionale perfect)
q_gram_b2_04_003.explanation: Il/la condizionale perfect (habríamos creído) indica something quello sarebbe avere happened if circumstances aveva been different. Creer's participio passato è creído.
q_gram_b2_04_003.hint: Il/la condizionale perfect esprime an unrealized past action

q_gram_b2_04_004.question: Quando è il/la condizionale perfect (habría + participio passato) used in spagnolo?
q_gram_b2_04_004.correct: To express what would have happened in the past under different circumstances, or to speculate about the past
wrong: To express what will have happened by a future point in time
To express what had happened before another past event
To express what someone wanted to happen in the present
q_gram_b2_04_004.explanation: Il/la condizionale perfect ha two main uses: (1) il/la main clause di Type 3 conditionals (cosa sarebbe avere happened), e (2) speculation o conjecture about past events.

q_gram_b2_04_005.question: Tú ___ la verdad antes, pero no te atreviste. (decir, condizionale perfect, forma tú)
q_gram_b2_04_005.explanation: Il/la condizionale perfect forma tú è habrías + participio passato. Decir ha il/la irregolare participio passato dicho.
q_gram_b2_04_005.conjugation_info: decir (conditional perfect): habría dicho, habrías dicho, habría dicho, habríamos dicho, habríais dicho, habrían dicho

q_gram_b2_04_006.question: ¿Quién ___ que ese equipo ganaría la final? (pensar, condizionale perfect)
q_gram_b2_04_006.explanation: Qui il/la condizionale perfect si usa per speculation about il/la past: 'Chi sarebbe avere thought...?' Il/la form è habría pensado.
q_gram_b2_04_006.hint: Il/la condizionale perfect può express past speculation

q_gram_b2_04_007.question: I sarebbe avere called tu, ma I lost my phone.
q_gram_b2_04_007.correct: Te habría llamado, pero perdí mi teléfono.
wrong: Te hubiera llamado, pero perdía mi teléfono.
Te llamaría, pero perdí mi teléfono.
Te había llamado, pero perdí mi teléfono.
q_gram_b2_04_007.explanation: Il/la condizionale perfect (habría llamado) esprime cosa sarebbe avere happened. Il/la 'pero' clause uses il/la passato remoto a state il/la factual obstacle.

q_gram_b2_04_008.question: Sin tu ayuda, yo no ___ el trabajo a tiempo. (completar, condizionale perfect)
q_gram_b2_04_008.explanation: 'Sin tu ayuda' (senza il tuo help) sets up an implied counterfactual past condition. Il/la condizionale perfect (habría completado) esprime il/la unrealized outcome.
q_gram_b2_04_008.hint: 'Sin + sostantivo' può introduce an implied past condition

q_gram_b2_04_009.question: A las diez de la noche, los invitados ya se habrían marchado.
q_gram_b2_04_009.correct: By ten at night, the guests would have already left.
wrong: At ten at night, the guests had already left.
By ten at night, the guests already left.
At ten at night, the guests would already leave.
q_gram_b2_04_009.explanation: Il/la condizionale perfect (se habrían marchado) qui esprime conjecture about cosa probably happened a a past tempo. 'Ya' (already) emphasizes il/la completed nature di il/la action.

q_gram_b2_04_010.question: Ellos ___ el vuelo si no hubiera habido tráfico. (perder, condizionale perfect, ellos form)
q_gram_b2_04_010.explanation: In il/la main clause di a Type 3 condizionale, il/la condizionale perfect si usa. Il/la negative form per ellos è 'no habrían perdido'. Perder's participio passato è perdido.
q_gram_b2_04_010.conjugation_info: perder (conditional perfect): habría perdido, habrías perdido, habría perdido, habríamos perdido, habríais perdido, habrían perdido

q_gram_b2_05_001.question: Para el próximo mes, yo ya ___ este libro. (leer, futuro anteriore)
q_gram_b2_05_001.explanation: Il/la futuro anteriore (habré + participio passato) esprime an action quello sarà essere completed da a future point. Leer's participio passato è leído.
q_gram_b2_05_001.hint: 'Para el próximo mes' indica a future deadline

q_gram_b2_05_002.question: Cuando tú llegues, nosotros ya ___ de cenar. (terminar, futuro anteriore)
q_gram_b2_05_002.explanation: Il/la futuro anteriore esprime quello an action sarà essere completed prima another future event. 'Habremos terminado' = 'we sarà avere finished'.
q_gram_b2_05_002.hint: 'Cuando llegues' sets a future reference point

q_gram_b2_05_003.question: Cosa sono il/la two main uses di il/la futuro anteriore tense in spagnolo?
q_gram_b2_05_003.correct: To express an action completed before a future point in time, and to speculate about what has probably happened
wrong: To express a habitual action in the future and a completed past action
To express a future plan and a condition for that plan
To express desire about the future and doubt about the present
q_gram_b2_05_003.explanation: Il/la futuro anteriore (habré hablado) serves two purposes: (1) actions completed da a future deadline, e (2) conjecture about recent past events (e.g., 'habrá salido' = 'he ha probably left').

q_gram_b2_05_004.question: Ella ___ toda la serie antes de que estrenen la nueva temporada. (ver, futuro anteriore, ella form)
q_gram_b2_05_004.explanation: Il/la futuro anteriore ella form è habrá + participio passato. Ver ha il/la irregolare participio passato visto.
q_gram_b2_05_004.conjugation_info: ver (future perfect): habré visto, habrás visto, habrá visto, habremos visto, habréis visto, habrán visto

q_gram_b2_05_005.question: ¿Dónde ___ mis llaves? No las encuentro por ningún lado. (poner, futuro anteriore, forma yo)
q_gram_b2_05_005.explanation: Qui il/la futuro anteriore esprime conjecture about a recent event: 'Dove può I avere put my keys?' Poner ha il/la irregolare participio passato puesto.
q_gram_b2_05_005.hint: Il/la futuro anteriore può express speculation about il/la recent past

q_gram_b2_05_006.question: Ellos ___ de la ciudad antes de que empiece la tormenta. (salir, futuro anteriore, ellos form)
q_gram_b2_05_006.explanation: Il/la futuro anteriore (habrán salido) indica il/la action sarà essere completed prima il/la storm begins. Il/la ellos form uses habrán + participio passato.
q_gram_b2_05_006.conjugation_info: salir (future perfect): habré salido, habrás salido, habrá salido, habremos salido, habréis salido, habrán salido

q_gram_b2_05_007.question: Para finales de año, la empresa ___ más de mil empleados. (contratar, futuro anteriore)
q_gram_b2_05_007.explanation: Il/la futuro anteriore si usa per express cosa sarà avere been completed da a future point. 'Para finales de año' sets il/la future deadline.
q_gram_b2_05_007.hint: 'Para finales de año' signals a future deadline

q_gram_b2_05_008.question: Da il/la tempo tu arrive, I sarà avere already prepared dinner.
q_gram_b2_05_008.correct: Para cuando llegues, yo ya habré preparado la cena.
wrong: Cuando llegas, yo ya preparé la cena.
Para cuando llegues, yo ya habría preparado la cena.
Cuando llegues, yo ya prepararé la cena.
q_gram_b2_05_008.explanation: Il/la futuro anteriore (habré preparado) esprime an action quello sarà essere completed prima another future event (il tuo arrival). 'Para cuando' + congiuntivo introduces il/la future reference point.

q_gram_b2_05_009.question: Vosotros ___ el informe antes de la reunión. (escribir, futuro anteriore, forma vosotros)
q_gram_b2_05_009.explanation: Il/la futuro anteriore forma vosotros è habréis + participio passato. Escribir ha il/la irregolare participio passato escrito.
q_gram_b2_05_009.conjugation_info: escribir (future perfect): habré escrito, habrás escrito, habrá escrito, habremos escrito, habréis escrito, habrán escrito

q_gram_b2_05_010.question: ¿Habrán recibido ya mi solicitud? La envié hace una semana.
q_gram_b2_05_010.correct: Will they have received my application already? I sent it a week ago.
wrong: Had they received my application already? I sent it a week ago.
Would they have received my application already? I sent it a week ago.
Did they receive my application already? I sent it a week ago.
q_gram_b2_05_010.explanation: Il/la futuro anteriore (habrán recibido) si usa qui a speculate about whether something ha probably happened. Esso translates as 'sarà loro avere received' o 'do tu think loro avere received'.

q_gram_b2_06_001.question: Yo ___ todo si me hubieras avisado antes. (comprender, trapassato congiuntivo, forma yo)
q_gram_b2_06_001.explanation: Il/la trapassato congiuntivo è formed con hubiera/hubiese + participio passato. Il/la forma yo è hubiera comprendido.
q_gram_b2_06_001.conjugation_info: comprender (pluperfect subjunctive): hubiera comprendido, hubieras comprendido, hubiera comprendido, hubiéramos comprendido, hubierais comprendido, hubieran comprendido

q_gram_b2_06_002.question: Ojalá que nosotros ___ más tiempo en esa ciudad. (pasar, trapassato congiuntivo)
q_gram_b2_06_002.explanation: 'Ojalá que' + trapassato congiuntivo esprime a wish about il/la past quello did not come true. Il/la forma nosotros è hubiéramos pasado.
q_gram_b2_06_002.hint: 'Ojalá que' + trapassato congiuntivo = unfulfilled past wish

q_gram_b2_06_003.question: Me molestó que ellos no ___ a la reunión. (venir, trapassato congiuntivo)
q_gram_b2_06_003.explanation: Dopo 'me molestó que' (esso bothered me quello), il/la trapassato congiuntivo si usa quando referring a an action prior a il/la past emotion. Il/la form è hubieran venido.
q_gram_b2_06_003.hint: Il/la emotion è past, e il/la action happened prima il/la emotion

q_gram_b2_06_004.question: Cosa è il/la difference between il/la past congiuntivo e il/la trapassato congiuntivo?
q_gram_b2_06_004.correct: The past subjunctive refers to present/future unreal situations, while the pluperfect subjunctive refers to past unreal situations that can no longer be changed
wrong: The past subjunctive is more formal than the pluperfect subjunctive
The pluperfect subjunctive is used only in si-clauses, while the past subjunctive is used everywhere else
The past subjunctive uses -ra endings and the pluperfect subjunctive uses -se endings
q_gram_b2_06_004.explanation: Il/la past congiuntivo (hablara) deals con present/future hypothetical situations, mentre il/la trapassato congiuntivo (hubiera hablado) deals con past counterfactual situations quello sono impossible a change.

q_gram_b2_06_005.question: Tú ___ el error si hubieras revisado el documento. (descubrir, trapassato congiuntivo, forma tú)
q_gram_b2_06_005.explanation: Il/la trapassato congiuntivo forma tú è hubieras + participio passato. Descubrir ha il/la irregolare participio passato descubierto.
q_gram_b2_06_005.conjugation_info: descubrir (pluperfect subjunctive): hubiera descubierto, hubieras descubierto, hubiera descubierto, hubiéramos descubierto, hubierais descubierto, hubieran descubierto

q_gram_b2_06_006.question: Dudaba que ella ___ la carta antes de la ceremonia. (escribir, trapassato congiuntivo)
q_gram_b2_06_006.explanation: Dopo 'dudaba que', il/la trapassato congiuntivo si usa quando il/la doubted action happened prior a il/la main verbo. Escribir ha il/la irregolare participio passato escrito.
q_gram_b2_06_006.hint: Il/la doubted action preceded il/la main verbo

q_gram_b2_06_007.question: I wish I aveva studied abroad quando I era young.
q_gram_b2_06_007.correct: Ojalá hubiera estudiado en el extranjero cuando era joven.
wrong: Ojalá estudiara en el extranjero cuando era joven.
Ojalá habría estudiado en el extranjero cuando era joven.
Ojalá había estudiado en el extranjero cuando era joven.
q_gram_b2_06_007.explanation: 'Ojalá' + trapassato congiuntivo (hubiera estudiado) esprime an impossible wish about il/la past. Il/la past congiuntivo (estudiara) sarebbe refer a il/la present o future instead.

q_gram_b2_06_008.question: No creía que ellos ___ la verdad hasta ese momento. (saber, trapassato congiuntivo)
q_gram_b2_06_008.explanation: Dopo 'no creía que', il/la trapassato congiuntivo è necessario perché il/la believed action occurred prima il/la main verbo (creía). Il/la form è hubieran sabido.
q_gram_b2_06_008.hint: Doubt in il/la past about an even earlier action

q_gram_b2_06_009.question: Era imposible que el tren hubiera llegado a tiempo con tanta nieve.
q_gram_b2_06_009.correct: It was impossible that the train had arrived on time with so much snow.
wrong: It is impossible that the train arrived on time with so much snow.
It was impossible that the train would arrive on time with so much snow.
It was impossible that the train will have arrived on time with so much snow.
q_gram_b2_06_009.explanation: Il/la trapassato congiuntivo (hubiera llegado) dopo 'era imposible que' esprime doubt about a completed past action. Esso translates naturally as 'aveva arrived' in inglese.

q_gram_b2_06_010.question: Nosotros ___ antes si hubiéramos tenido más información. (actuar, condizionale perfect, forma nosotros)
q_gram_b2_06_010.explanation: In il/la result clause di a Type 3 condizionale, il/la condizionale perfect si usa. Il/la forma nosotros è habríamos + participio passato: habríamos actuado.
q_gram_b2_06_010.conjugation_info: actuar (conditional perfect): habría actuado, habrías actuado, habría actuado, habríamos actuado, habríais actuado, habrían actuado

q_gram_b2_07_001.question: Aunque ___ mucho, iremos a la excursión. (llover, congiuntivo presente)
q_gram_b2_07_001.explanation: 'Aunque' + congiuntivo esprime a concession about something uncertain o hypothetical. Poiché il/la rain è uncertain, il/la congiuntivo presente (llueva) si usa.

q_gram_b2_07_002.question: Aunque María ___ enferma ayer, fue a trabajar. (estar, indicativo)
q_gram_b2_07_002.explanation: 'Aunque' + indicativo esprime a concession about a known fact. Poiché María era actually sick (a fact), il/la imperfetto indicativo (estaba) si usa.

q_gram_b2_07_003.question: Come does il/la mood (indicativo vs. congiuntivo) change il/la significato di 'aunque'?
q_gram_b2_07_003.correct: 'Aunque' + indicative means 'although' (stating a fact), while 'aunque' + subjunctive means 'even if' (uncertain or hypothetical)
wrong: 'Aunque' + indicative is for present tense and 'aunque' + subjunctive is for past tense
'Aunque' + indicative is informal and 'aunque' + subjunctive is formal
'Aunque' + indicative is for positive statements and 'aunque' + subjunctive is for negative ones
q_gram_b2_07_003.explanation: Il/la choice between indicativo e congiuntivo dopo 'aunque' depends on whether il/la speaker presents il/la information as a known fact (indicativo) o as uncertain/hypothetical (congiuntivo).

q_gram_b2_07_004.question: Aunque ella no ___ de acuerdo, aceptó la decisión. (estar, past indicativo, ella form)
q_gram_b2_07_004.explanation: Poiché il/la sentence states a past fact (she era not in agreement), il/la indicativo si usa con 'aunque'. Il/la imperfetto estaba descrive an ongoing past state.
q_gram_b2_07_004.conjugation_info: estar (imperfect indicative): estaba, estabas, estaba, estábamos, estabais, estaban

q_gram_b2_07_005.question: Aunque ___ todo el dinero del mundo, no podría comprar la felicidad. (tener, past congiuntivo)
q_gram_b2_07_005.explanation: 'Aunque' + past congiuntivo esprime a hypothetical concession about an unreal present situation. Having tutti il/la money in il/la world è clearly hypothetical.
q_gram_b2_07_005.hint: Questo è clearly a hypothetical, unreal scenario

q_gram_b2_07_006.question: Nosotros ___ el proyecto aunque el jefe no lo aprobara. (continuar, condizionale, forma nosotros)
q_gram_b2_07_006.explanation: Il/la main clause paired con 'aunque' + past congiuntivo uses il/la condizionale per esprimere cosa sarebbe happen despite il/la concession.
q_gram_b2_07_006.conjugation_info: continuar (conditional): continuaría, continuarías, continuaría, continuaríamos, continuaríais, continuarían

q_gram_b2_07_007.question: Aunque ___ cansados, los jugadores siguieron entrenando con intensidad. (estar, indicativo)
q_gram_b2_07_007.explanation: Poiché il/la fatigue è presented as a known fact (il/la players erano actually tired), 'aunque' è seguito da il/la indicativo. Il/la imperfetto (estaban) descrive il/la ongoing state.
q_gram_b2_07_007.hint: Il/la tiredness era real, not hypothetical

q_gram_b2_07_008.question: Even if loro offered me double il/la salary, I sarebbe not accept quello job.
q_gram_b2_07_008.correct: Aunque me ofrecieran el doble del salario, no aceptaría ese trabajo.
wrong: Aunque me ofrecen el doble del salario, no acepto ese trabajo.
Aunque me ofrecerían el doble del salario, no aceptaría ese trabajo.
Aunque me ofrezcan el doble del salario, no acepté ese trabajo.
q_gram_b2_07_008.explanation: 'Even if' esprime a hypothetical concession, requiring 'aunque' + past congiuntivo (ofrecieran) per a present unreal condition, con il/la condizionale (aceptaría) in il/la main clause.

q_gram_b2_07_009.question: Tú ___ la misma decisión aunque pudieras volver atrás en el tiempo. (tomar, condizionale, forma tú)
q_gram_b2_07_009.explanation: In il/la main clause di a concessive sentence con 'aunque' + past congiuntivo, il/la condizionale si usa. Il/la tú condizionale di tomar è tomarías.
q_gram_b2_07_009.conjugation_info: tomar (conditional): tomaría, tomarías, tomaría, tomaríamos, tomaríais, tomarían

q_gram_b2_07_010.question: Aunque no tenga experiencia, va a solicitar el puesto de trabajo.
q_gram_b2_07_010.correct: Even though she may not have experience, she is going to apply for the position.
wrong: Although she does not have experience, she applied for the position.
Even if she had no experience, she would apply for the position.
Although she did not have experience, she was going to apply for the position.
q_gram_b2_07_010.explanation: 'Aunque' + congiuntivo presente (tenga) indica uncertainty about il/la conceded fact ('she may o may not avere experience'), mentre il/la indicativo main clause (va a solicitar) states il/la definite intention.

q_gram_b2_08_001.question: La mujer ___ hijos estudian en el extranjero vive en mi calle. (relative pronome per possession)
q_gram_b2_08_001.explanation: 'Cuyo/a/os/as' è il/la possessive relative pronome significato 'whose'. Esso concorda con il sostantivo esso modifies (hijos, maschile plurale), so cuyos è corretto.
q_gram_b2_08_001.conjugation_info: cuyo (possessive relative): cuyo (m.sg.), cuya (f.sg.), cuyos (m.pl.), cuyas (f.pl.)

q_gram_b2_08_002.question: La empresa para ___ trabajo tiene oficinas en toda Europa. (relative pronome dopo preposition)
q_gram_b2_08_002.explanation: Dopo prepositions, 'el cual/la cual/los cuales/las cuales' si usa, specialmente in formale o written Spagnolo. Poiché 'empresa' è femminile singolare, 'la cual' è corretto.
q_gram_b2_08_002.hint: Il/la relative pronome deve agree con 'empresa' (femminile)

q_gram_b2_08_003.question: El edificio en ___ vivimos fue construido en el siglo XIX. (relative pronome dopo 'en')
q_gram_b2_08_003.explanation: Dopo prepositions like 'en', il/la construction 'el/la cual' o 'el/la que' può essere used. Poiché 'edificio' è maschile singolare, 'el cual' è corretto.
q_gram_b2_08_003.hint: Dopo a preposition, use 'el/la cual' o 'el/la que'

q_gram_b2_08_004.question: Cosa è il/la difference between 'que', 'el cual', e 'cuyo' as relative pronouns?
q_gram_b2_08_004.correct: 'Que' is the most common relative pronoun, 'el cual' is used after prepositions or for clarity, and 'cuyo' expresses possession (whose)
wrong: 'Que' is for people, 'el cual' is for things, and 'cuyo' is for places
'Que' is informal, 'el cual' is formal, and 'cuyo' is archaic
'Que' is for subjects, 'el cual' is for objects, and 'cuyo' is for indirect objects
q_gram_b2_08_004.explanation: 'Que' è il/la default relative pronome. 'El cual/la cual' è preferred dopo prepositions o quando clarifying quale antecedent è referred a. 'Cuyo' functions as a possessive aggettivo significato 'whose'.

q_gram_b2_08_005.question: Las razones por ___ dimitió el director no están claras. (relative pronome dopo 'por', plurale)
q_gram_b2_08_005.explanation: Dopo il/la preposition 'por', 'las cuales' si usa e concorda con 'razones' (femminile plurale). 'Por las cuales' significa 'per quale / perché di quale'.
q_gram_b2_08_005.conjugation_info: el cual (relative pronoun): el cual (m.sg.), la cual (f.sg.), los cuales (m.pl.), las cuales (f.pl.)

q_gram_b2_08_006.question: Tengo una amiga ___ madre es médica y ___ padre es abogado. (cuyo, two blanks)
q_gram_b2_08_006.explanation: 'Cuyo/a' concorda con il/la possessed sostantivo, not il/la possessor. 'Madre' è femminile (cuya) e 'padre' è maschile (cuyo).
q_gram_b2_08_006.hint: 'Cuyo' concorda con il sostantivo quello follows esso, not il/la antecedent

q_gram_b2_08_007.question: Il/la city in quale we met ha changed a lot.
q_gram_b2_08_007.correct: La ciudad en la cual nos conocimos ha cambiado mucho.
wrong: La ciudad en que nos conocíamos ha cambiado mucho.
La ciudad cuya nos conocimos ha cambiado mucho.
La ciudad la cual nos conocimos ha cambiado mucho.
q_gram_b2_08_007.explanation: 'En la cual' (in quale) è il/la formale relative pronome construction dopo a preposition. 'La cual' concorda con 'ciudad' (femminile singolare). Il/la passato remoto 'conocimos' si usa per il/la specific past event.

q_gram_b2_08_008.question: El autor ___ novela ganó el premio es de Colombia. (cuyo, agreeing con 'novela')
q_gram_b2_08_008.explanation: 'Cuya' deve agree con 'novela' (femminile singolare), not con 'autor' (maschile). Questo è un key regola: cuyo concorda con il sostantivo esso modifies (il/la possessed thing).
q_gram_b2_08_008.hint: Remember: cuyo concorda con il/la following sostantivo, not il/la antecedent

q_gram_b2_08_009.question: Visitamos el museo, el cual había sido renovado recientemente.
q_gram_b2_08_009.correct: We visited the museum, which had been recently renovated.
wrong: We visited the museum whose renovation was recent.
We visited the museum that had been recently renovated.
We visited the museum in which had been recently renovated.
q_gram_b2_08_009.explanation: 'El cual' si usa qui in a non-restrictive relative clause (set off da a comma) a add extra information about 'el museo'. Esso translates as 'quale' in inglese.

q_gram_b2_08_010.question: Los problemas con ___ nos enfrentamos son muy complejos. (relative pronome dopo 'con', maschile plurale)
q_gram_b2_08_010.explanation: Dopo il/la preposition 'con', 'los cuales' si usa e concorda con 'problemas' (maschile plurale). 'Con los cuales' significa 'con quale'.
q_gram_b2_08_010.conjugation_info: el cual (relative pronoun): el cual (m.sg.), la cual (f.sg.), los cuales (m.pl.), las cuales (f.pl.)

q_gram_b2_09_001.question: ___ importante es que todos participen en la decisión. (lo + aggettivo)
q_gram_b2_09_001.explanation: 'Lo + aggettivo' creates a nominalized abstract concept. 'Lo importante' significa 'il/la important thing / cosa è important'. 'Lo' è a neuter articolo used per abstraction.

q_gram_b2_09_002.question: No entiendes ___ difícil que es aprender un idioma nuevo. (lo + aggettivo)
q_gram_b2_09_002.explanation: 'Lo + aggettivo + que' si usa per express il/la degree o extent di something: 'come difficult esso è'. Il/la neuter articolo 'lo' nominalizes l'aggettivo in questo construction.

q_gram_b2_09_003.question: Cosa does il/la construction 'lo que' significare, e come è esso used?
q_gram_b2_09_003.correct: 'Lo que' means 'what' or 'that which' and introduces a noun clause referring to an abstract idea or an entire concept
wrong: 'Lo que' means 'how much' and is used to express quantity
'Lo que' means 'the one who' and refers to a specific person
'Lo que' means 'which one' and is used in questions only
q_gram_b2_09_003.explanation: 'Lo que' nominalizes an entire clause: 'lo que quiero' = 'cosa I want / quello quale I want'. Esso può function as subject o object e si riferisce a abstract concepts rather than specific nouns.

q_gram_b2_09_004.question: Lo que necesitamos ___ más tiempo para terminar el proyecto. (ser, indicativo presente, 3rd persona)
q_gram_b2_09_004.explanation: 'Lo que' + clause acts as a singolare subject, so il verbo 'ser' è conjugated in il/la third persona singolare: es. 'Lo que necesitamos es...' = 'Cosa we need è...'
q_gram_b2_09_004.conjugation_info: ser (present indicative): soy, eres, es, somos, sois, son

q_gram_b2_09_005.question: ___ que me preocupa es la falta de comunicación entre los departamentos. (nominalization)
q_gram_b2_09_005.explanation: 'Lo que' introduces a nominalized clause significato 'cosa' o 'quello quale'. 'Lo que me preocupa' = 'cosa worries me'. Esso functions as il soggetto di il/la sentence.
q_gram_b2_09_005.hint: Use il/la neuter articolo a introduce 'cosa' as a subject

q_gram_b2_09_006.question: Ella no sabe ___ bueno que es este restaurante. (lo + aggettivo, ella form context)
q_gram_b2_09_006.explanation: 'Lo + aggettivo + que' esprime degree o extent: 'come good questo restaurant è'. Il/la neuter 'lo' nominalizes l'aggettivo in an exclamatory sense.
q_gram_b2_09_006.conjugation_info: Nominalization pattern: lo + adjective + que + clause (expresses degree/extent)

q_gram_b2_09_007.question: No imaginas ___ rápido que pasa el tiempo cuando estás ocupado. (lo + aggettivo)
q_gram_b2_09_007.explanation: 'Lo + aggettivo/avverbio + que' si usa per emphasize il/la degree di something. 'Lo rápido que pasa el tiempo' = 'come fast tempo goes da'.
q_gram_b2_09_007.hint: Questo construction emphasizes il/la degree o extent

q_gram_b2_09_008.question: Cosa I like la maggior parte about questo city è its architecture.
q_gram_b2_09_008.correct: Lo que más me gusta de esta ciudad es su arquitectura.

q_gram_b2_09_008.explanation: 'Lo que' introduces il/la nominalized clause 'cosa I like la maggior parte'. Poiché il/la concept è abstract (not referring a a specific maschile o sostantivo femminile), il/la neuter 'lo' è obbligatorio.

q_gram_b2_09_009.question: Lo malo de vivir en el centro ___ el ruido constante. (ser, present, 3rd persona singolare)
q_gram_b2_09_009.explanation: 'Lo malo' (il/la bad thing) è a nominalized abstract concept using 'lo + aggettivo'. Esso acts as a singolare subject, requiring 'es' (third persona singolare di ser).
q_gram_b2_09_009.conjugation_info: ser (present indicative): soy, eres, es, somos, sois, son

q_gram_b2_09_010.question: Lo que no me esperaba era que cancelaran el vuelo sin previo aviso.
q_gram_b2_09_010.correct: What I did not expect was that they would cancel the flight without prior notice.
wrong: The thing I was not expecting was that they canceled the flight without previous notice.
What I am not expecting is that they cancel the flight without notice.
Which I did not expect was that they would cancel the flight without prior notice.
q_gram_b2_09_010.explanation: 'Lo que' significa 'cosa' (quello quale). 'No me esperaba' è in il/la imperfetto (ongoing past expectation). 'Cancelaran' è past congiuntivo perché esso follows a sostantivo clause expressing an unexpected event.

q_gram_b2_10_001.question: Quería ir al concierto; ___, no pude conseguir entradas. (discourse connector: tuttavia)
q_gram_b2_10_001.explanation: 'Sin embargo' significa 'tuttavia/nevertheless' e introduces a contrasting idea. Esso connects two clauses dove il/la second contradicts o limits il/la first.
q_gram_b2_10_001.conjugation_info: Common contrast connectors: sin embargo (however), no obstante (nevertheless), a pesar de eso (despite that)

q_gram_b2_10_002.question: La empresa ha reducido costos. ___, los beneficios han aumentado este trimestre. (consequence connector)
q_gram_b2_10_002.explanation: 'Por lo tanto' significa 'quindi' e introduces a logical consequence. Il/la cost reduction leads a increased profits, so a consequence connector è necessario.
q_gram_b2_10_002.hint: Il/la second sentence è a logical result di il/la first

q_gram_b2_10_003.question: El proyecto fue difícil. ___, el equipo logró terminarlo a tiempo. (contrast connector)
q_gram_b2_10_003.explanation: 'No obstante' significa 'nevertheless/tuttavia' e introduces a contrast. Despite il/la difficulty, il/la team finished on tempo, so a concessive connector è appropriate.
q_gram_b2_10_003.hint: Il/la second clause contrasts con il/la expectation set da il/la first

q_gram_b2_10_004.question: Cosa è il/la function di discourse connectors like 'sin embargo', 'por lo tanto', e 'en cambio'?
q_gram_b2_10_004.correct: They link ideas between sentences or paragraphs by showing contrast, consequence, addition, or other logical relationships
wrong: They replace conjunctions like 'y', 'o', and 'pero' in all cases
They are only used in formal written language and never in speech
They modify verbs to indicate the speaker's attitude toward the action
q_gram_b2_10_004.explanation: Discourse connectors (conectores del discurso) organize text da showing relationships between ideas: contrast (sin embargo), consequence (por lo tanto), replacement (en cambio), addition (además), etc.

q_gram_b2_10_005.question: No me gusta el frío. ___, me gusta la nieve en invierno. (connector: despite quello, yo context)
q_gram_b2_10_005.explanation: 'A pesar de eso' significa 'despite quello' e introduces a concessive idea. Il/la speaker dislikes cold ma likes snow, quale è a partial contradiction.
q_gram_b2_10_005.conjugation_info: Concessive connectors: sin embargo, no obstante, a pesar de eso, con todo, aun así

q_gram_b2_10_006.question: Estudió mucho para el examen; ___, aprobó con la mejor nota de la clase. (consequence connector)
q_gram_b2_10_006.explanation: 'Por consiguiente' significa 'consequently/as a result'. Studying hard logically leads a a good grade, so a consequence connector è appropriate.
q_gram_b2_10_006.hint: Il/la second clause è a result di il/la first

q_gram_b2_10_007.question: He does not like going out a night. On il/la other hand, his brother goes out ogni weekend.
q_gram_b2_10_007.correct: No le gusta salir por la noche. En cambio, su hermano sale todos los fines de semana.
wrong: No le gusta salir por la noche. Sin embargo, su hermano sale todos los fines de semana.
No le gusta salir por la noche. Por lo tanto, su hermano sale todos los fines de semana.
No le gusta salir por la noche. Es decir, su hermano sale todos los fines de semana.
q_gram_b2_10_007.explanation: 'En cambio' significa 'on il/la other hand / da contrast' e introduces a contrasting comparison between two different subjects. Esso emphasizes il/la difference between il/la two brothers.

q_gram_b2_10_008.question: El restaurante estaba lleno; ___, decidimos ir a otro lugar. (consequence connector)
q_gram_b2_10_008.explanation: 'Por eso' significa 'quello è perché / per quello reason' e introduces a consequence. Il/la restaurant being full caused il/la decision a go elsewhere.
q_gram_b2_10_008.hint: Il/la decision era a consequence di il/la restaurant being full

q_gram_b2_10_009.question: La situación económica es difícil; no obstante, la empresa sigue creciendo.
q_gram_b2_10_009.correct: The economic situation is difficult; nevertheless, the company continues to grow.
wrong: The economic situation is difficult; therefore, the company continues to grow.
The economic situation is difficult; that is, the company continues to grow.
The economic situation is difficult; on the other hand, the company continues to grow.
q_gram_b2_10_009.explanation: 'No obstante' significa 'nevertheless/tuttavia' e introduces a contrasting result. Despite difficult economics, il/la company è still growing, quale defies expectations.

q_gram_b2_10_010.question: La propuesta fue aprobada. ___, debemos empezar a implementarla cuanto antes. (consequence connector, nosotros context)
q_gram_b2_10_010.explanation: 'Por consiguiente' significa 'consequently' e introduces a logical result. Il/la approval di il/la proposal naturally leads a il/la need a implement esso.
q_gram_b2_10_010.conjugation_info: Consequence connectors: por lo tanto, por consiguiente, por eso, en consecuencia, de ahí que

q_gram_b2_11_001.question: Los niños ___ a jugar en el parque después de comer. (ir a + infinito, passato remoto)
q_gram_b2_11_001.explanation: 'Ir a + infinito' è a verbal periphrasis quello esprime intention o imminent action. In il/la passato remoto, 'fueron a jugar' indica loro went e played.
q_gram_b2_11_001.hint: Questo è un completed past action, use il/la passato remoto di 'ir'

q_gram_b2_11_002.question: Después del divorcio, ella ___ a empezar su vida de nuevo. (volver a + infinito, passato remoto)
q_gram_b2_11_002.explanation: 'Volver a + infinito' significa 'a do something again'. In il/la passato remoto, 'volvió a empezar' = 'she started over again / she began again'.
q_gram_b2_11_002.hint: 'Volver a' + infinito = a do something again

q_gram_b2_11_003.question: Cosa does il/la verbal periphrasis 'dejar de + infinito' express?
q_gram_b2_11_003.correct: The cessation or stopping of an action (to stop doing something)
wrong: The beginning of a new action (to start doing something)
The repetition of an action (to do something again)
The continuation of an ongoing action (to keep doing something)
q_gram_b2_11_003.explanation: 'Dejar de + infinito' significa 'a stop/quit doing something'. Per esempio, 'dejó de fumar' = 'he/she stopped smoking'. Esso indica il/la end o interruption di an activity.

q_gram_b2_11_004.question: Cuando empezó a llover, los niños ___ a correr hacia la casa. (ponerse a + infinito, passato remoto, ellos form)

q_gram_b2_16_007.question: He è not lazy, ma rather molto hardworking.

wrong: No es perezoso, pero muy trabajador.
No es perezoso, sino que muy trabajador.
q_gram_b2_16_007.explanation: 'Sino' si usa dopo il/la negative clause 'no es perezoso' a introduce il/la direct correction. Poiché esso contrasts two adjectives (not a conjugated verbo), 'sino' alone è corretto.

q_gram_b2_16_008.question: El problema no es difícil, ___ requiere mucha paciencia. (pero/sino)
q_gram_b2_16_008.explanation: Qui 'pero' è corretto perché il/la second clause does not directly contradict o replace il/la first. Esso adds additional information: il/la problem è not difficult, Ma esso requires patience.
q_gram_b2_16_008.hint: Il/la second clause adds information, esso does not replace 'difícil'

q_gram_b2_16_009.question: No fue Pedro quien lo hizo, sino que fue María la responsable.
q_gram_b2_16_009.correct: It was not Pedro who did it, but rather it was María who was responsible.
wrong: It was not Pedro who did it, but María was responsible.
It was not Pedro who did it, however María was responsible.
Pedro did not do it, so María was responsible.
q_gram_b2_16_009.explanation: 'Sino que' introduces a full clause quello directly corrects il/la negative statement. 'Not Pedro ma rather María' è a direct replacement di il/la agent, e poiché a conjugated verbo follows, 'sino que' si usa.

q_gram_b2_16_010.question: No ___ llegó tarde, sino que además no trajo los documentos. (solo, completing 'no solo... sino que además')
q_gram_b2_16_010.explanation: 'No solo... sino que además...' significa 'not solo... ma anche...'. Quando a conjugated verbo follows, 'sino que' si usa. 'Además' (anche/in addition) reinforces il/la additive significato.
q_gram_b2_16_010.conjugation_info: Extended pattern: no solo + clause, sino que además + clause (not only... but also/moreover)

q_gram_b2_17_001.question: Quiero que tú ___ a la fiesta esta noche. (venir, congiuntivo presente)
q_gram_b2_17_001.explanation: Quando il/la main verbo è in il/la present tense (quiero), il/la subordinate clause uses il/la congiuntivo presente (vengas) according a il/la sequence di tenses. Present → Congiuntivo presente.
q_gram_b2_17_001.hint: Main verbo present tense → subordinate congiuntivo presente

q_gram_b2_17_002.question: El profesor pidió que los estudiantes ___ el ensayo para el viernes. (entregar, past congiuntivo)
q_gram_b2_17_002.explanation: Quando il/la main verbo è in il/la past tense (pidió, passato remoto), il/la subordinate clause uses il/la past congiuntivo (entregaran). Past → Past Congiuntivo.
q_gram_b2_17_002.hint: Main verbo past tense → subordinate past congiuntivo

q_gram_b2_17_003.question: Cosa è il/la regola di sequence di tenses (concordancia temporal) per il/la congiuntivo in spagnolo?
q_gram_b2_17_003.correct: Present/future/present perfect main verb → present subjunctive; past main verb (preterite, imperfect, pluperfect, conditional) → past subjunctive
wrong: The subjunctive always matches the exact tense of the main verb
Present main verb → past subjunctive; past main verb → present subjunctive
There is no fixed rule; any subjunctive tense can follow any main verb tense
q_gram_b2_17_003.explanation: Il/la sequence di tenses governs quale congiuntivo tense follows il/la main verbo. Present-sphere verbs trigger congiuntivo presente; past-sphere verbs trigger past congiuntivo (congiuntivo imperfetto).

q_gram_b2_17_004.question: Dudaba que ella ___ la verdad. (decir, past congiuntivo, ella form)
q_gram_b2_17_004.explanation: Poiché 'dudaba' è in il/la imperfetto (past sphere), il/la subordinate clause requires il/la past congiuntivo. Decir's past congiuntivo è dijera (da il/la irregolare passato remoto radice dij-).
q_gram_b2_17_004.conjugation_info: decir (past subjunctive): dijera, dijeras, dijera, dijéramos, dijerais, dijeran

q_gram_b2_17_005.question: Es importante que todos ___ a tiempo a la reunión de mañana. (llegar, congiuntivo presente)
q_gram_b2_17_005.explanation: 'Es importante' è present tense (present sphere), so il/la congiuntivo in il/la subordinate clause deve anche essere present: lleguen. Present → Congiuntivo presente.
q_gram_b2_17_005.hint: 'Es importante' è present tense, triggering congiuntivo presente

q_gram_b2_17_006.question: Me alegraría que tú ___ a visitarme este verano. (venir, past congiuntivo, forma tú)
q_gram_b2_17_006.explanation: Il/la condizionale 'me alegraría' belongs a il/la past sphere, so esso triggers il/la past congiuntivo. Venir's past congiuntivo forma tú è vinieras (da il/la passato remoto radice vinier-).
q_gram_b2_17_006.conjugation_info: venir (past subjunctive): viniera, vinieras, viniera, viniéramos, vinierais, vinieran

q_gram_b2_17_007.question: No creo que ellos ___ la tarea todavía. (terminar, congiuntivo presente)
q_gram_b2_17_007.explanation: 'No creo' (present sphere) triggers congiuntivo presente. Poiché il/la action may essere completed ('todavía' = yet), il/la passato prossimo congiuntivo (hayan terminado) è appropriate per esprimere a completed action within il/la present sphere.
q_gram_b2_17_007.hint: Present tense main verbo + completed action = passato prossimo congiuntivo

q_gram_b2_17_008.question: Il/la teacher wanted il/la students a study more per il/la exam.
q_gram_b2_17_008.correct: El profesor quería que los estudiantes estudiaran más para el examen.
wrong: El profesor quería que los estudiantes estudien más para el examen.
El profesor quería que los estudiantes estudiarían más para el examen.
El profesor quería que los estudiantes estudiaban más para el examen.
q_gram_b2_17_008.explanation: 'Quería' (imperfetto, past sphere) triggers il/la past congiuntivo 'estudiaran'. Il/la sequence di tenses requires past → past congiuntivo.

q_gram_b2_17_009.question: Sería necesario que nosotros ___ antes de tomar una decisión. (hablar, past congiuntivo, forma nosotros)
q_gram_b2_17_009.explanation: Il/la condizionale 'sería' belongs a il/la past sphere, triggering il/la past congiuntivo. Il/la forma nosotros è habláramos (note il/la accent on il/la a).
q_gram_b2_17_009.conjugation_info: hablar (past subjunctive): hablara, hablaras, hablara, habláramos, hablarais, hablaran

q_gram_b2_17_010.question: Le pedí que me llamara cuando llegara al aeropuerto.
q_gram_b2_17_010.correct: I asked him/her to call me when he/she arrived at the airport.
wrong: I ask him/her to call me when he/she arrives at the airport.
I asked him/her to call me when he/she would arrive at the airport.
I had asked him/her to call me when he/she has arrived at the airport.
q_gram_b2_17_010.explanation: Both 'llamara' e 'llegara' sono past congiuntivo, following il/la past-sphere main verbo 'pedí' (passato remoto). Il/la sequence di tenses dictates quello both subordinate verbs use il/la past congiuntivo.

q_gram_b2_18_001.question: La casa ___ que vivimos tiene más de cien años. (preposition + relative, en + el/la que)
q_gram_b2_18_001.explanation: Dopo prepositions, 'el/la/los/las que' o 'el/la cual' si usa. 'La casa en la que vivimos' = 'il/la house in quale we live'. 'La que' concorda con 'casa' (femminile singolare).
q_gram_b2_18_001.conjugation_info: Preposition + article + que: en el que (m.sg.), en la que (f.sg.), en los que (m.pl.), en las que (f.pl.)

q_gram_b2_18_002.question: La razón ___ que se mudaron fue el clima. (preposition + relative pronome)
q_gram_b2_18_002.explanation: 'La razón por la que' significa 'il/la reason per quale / il/la reason perché'. Il/la preposition 'por' indica cause, e 'la que' concorda con 'razón' (femminile singolare).
q_gram_b2_18_002.hint: 'La razón por la que' = il/la reason perché

q_gram_b2_18_003.question: El amigo ___ quien fui al cine es de Argentina. (preposition + relative pronome per persone)
q_gram_b2_18_003.explanation: 'Con quien' significa 'con whom' e si usa per persone dopo il/la preposition 'con'. 'El amigo con quien fui' = 'il/la friend con whom I went'.

q_gram_b2_18_004.question: Quando do tu use 'preposition + el/la que' versus 'preposition + quien' in relative clauses?
q_gram_b2_18_004.correct: 'Preposition + quien/quienes' is used only for people, while 'preposition + el/la/los/las que' can be used for both people and things
wrong: 'Quien' is formal and 'el que' is informal
'Quien' is for subjects and 'el que' is for objects
'Quien' is singular only and 'el que' is plural only
q_gram_b2_18_004.explanation: 'Quien/quienes' può solo refer a persone: 'la persona con quien hablé'. 'El/la que' è more versatile e works per both persone e things: 'el tema del que hablamos', 'la persona de la que hablé'.

q_gram_b2_18_005.question: Los estudiantes ___ quienes el profesor dirigió sus palabras estaban muy atentos. (preposition + relative, 'a' + quienes)
q_gram_b2_18_005.explanation: 'A quienes' significa 'a whom' e indica il/la indirect object. 'Los estudiantes a quienes el profesor dirigió sus palabras' = 'il/la students a whom il/la professor directed his words'.
q_gram_b2_18_005.conjugation_info: Common preposition + quien(es) patterns: con quien(es) (with whom), a quien(es) (to whom), de quien(es) (of/about whom), para quien(es) (for whom)

q_gram_b2_18_006.question: El hotel ___ el que nos alojamos tenía unas vistas increíbles. (preposition 'in' + relative)
q_gram_b2_18_006.explanation: 'En el que' significa 'in quale'. 'El hotel en el que nos alojamos' = 'il/la hotel in quale we stayed'. Il/la preposition 'en' indica location.

q_gram_b2_18_007.question: Il/la book about quale we spoke è molto interesting.
q_gram_b2_18_007.correct: El libro del que hablamos es muy interesante.
wrong: El libro que del hablamos es muy interesante.
El libro sobre quien hablamos es muy interesante.
El libro de que hablamos es muy interesante.
q_gram_b2_18_007.explanation: 'Hablar de algo' (a talk about something) requires il/la preposition 'de'. Combined con il/la relative pronome: 'del que' (de + el que). 'El libro del que hablamos' = 'il/la book about quale we spoke'.

q_gram_b2_18_008.question: La empresa ___ la que trabajo ofrece buenos beneficios. (preposition + relative, 'per' in il/la sense di employment)
q_gram_b2_18_008.explanation: 'Trabajar para' significa 'a work per' (a company). 'La empresa para la que trabajo' = 'il/la company per quale I work'. 'Para' indica purpose o beneficiary.

q_gram_b2_18_009.question: El problema por el que estamos aquí es la falta de financiación.
q_gram_b2_18_009.correct: The problem for which we are here is the lack of funding.
wrong: The problem that we are here is the lack of funding.
The problem because we are here is the lack of funding.
The problem with which we are here is the lack of funding.
q_gram_b2_18_009.explanation: 'Por el que' significa 'per quale / perché di quale'. 'El problema por el que estamos aquí' uses il/la preposition 'por' per indicare il/la cause o reason.

q_gram_b2_18_010.question: Las personas ___ las que confío son muy pocas. (preposition 'in' per trust + relative, plurale femminile)
q_gram_b2_18_010.explanation: 'Confiar en' significa 'a trust in'. 'Las personas en las que confío' = 'il/la persone in whom I trust'. Il/la preposition 'en' è obbligatorio da il verbo 'confiar'.
q_gram_b2_18_010.conjugation_info: Verbs with fixed prepositions + relative: confiar en (en el/la que), depender de (del/de la que), pensar en (en el/la que), hablar de (del/de la que)
